## Google Cloud solutions for healthcare and life sciences

#### Healthcare

Google Cloud empowers healthcare organizations with advanced AI and data solutions to drive transformation in patient care and experiences, maximize operational efficiency, and accelerate clinician and employee productivity.

Explore all healthcare solutions[](https://cloud.google.com/solutions/healthcare-delivery)

#### Life Sciences

With advanced AI and cloud solutions, Google Cloud helps life science organizations drive sustainable and efficient operations, innovate in discovery, clinical development and personalize delivery to improve experiences of clinicians and patients.

Explore all life sciences solutions[](https://cloud.google.com/solutions/life-sciences)

### Solutions transforming the healthcare and life sciences value chains

#### Accelerate operations, patient outreach, and engagement, while ensuring security, privacy, and compliance.

[Gemini Enterprise app](https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise) with multi-modal search and powerful LLMs, reshapes how teams work. Patient charts, images, and lab reports can be analyzed to deliver faster insights and a complete view of the patient. Clinical, research, and manufacturing data can be summarized, leading to faster time to market for new therapies. AI agents automate administrative tasks, freeing up time for teams to focus on higher priority work.

Marketers leverage Google AI to accelerate personalized patient and practitioner outreach, delivering relevant educational content at scale based on health journeys, preferences, and language.

[Gemini Code Assist](https://codeassist.google/) helps R&D teams automate tasks including code generation, testing, and validation for regulatory compliance (like GxP and GCP), allowing engineers to focus on critical design for novel therapies and clinical applications.

## Google Cloud AI is uniquely positioned to help healthcare and life sciences organizations transform and accelerate growth

Multimodal AI reasoning

Empower teams with Gemini to improve productivity and business outcomes. Like humans, Google AI doesn't just understand words, but also images, videos, and sounds. This technology allows organizations to get a much richer understanding of information, leading to better decision-making, more efficient operations, and more personalized patient experiences.

Learn more about [Gemini](https://cloud.google.com/products/gemini) →

Integrated AI platform with optionality and choice

Capitalize on a unified platform to deploy AI agents and experiences quickly and securely. Build, deploy, and scale solutions with Gemini and Google Cloud's flexible, end-to-end platform Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. Work with any model to accelerate innovation.

Learn more about [Google AI](https://cloud.google.com/ai) →

Secure platform built for HCLS compliance

Google Cloud offers a secure and integrated platform built for HCLS compliance, providing governance and choice, while protecting patient data as you innovate.

Learn more about [compliance for HCLS at Google Cloud](https://cloud.google.com/security/compliance/offerings#/industries=Healthcare_and_life_sciences) →

Specialized HCLS partner ecosystem for expedited deployment

### Frequently asked questions

Expand all

#### How does Google Cloud help healthcare and life sciences organizations leverage AI responsibly?

Google Cloud provides enterprise-ready platforms like Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform with built-in governance and security controls, grounding features to improve accuracy, explainability tooling, and operate under strict AI principles. And we provide guidance to help you align with the Secure AI Framework, including a detailed risk assessment.

#### What are AI Agents, and how can they help my business?

AI agents are software systems that understand goals and act autonomously (or semi-autonomously) to complete tasks. They can boost clinical staff productivity, enhance patient and customer experiences, automate complex workflows, and unlock data insights, all driving efficiency and growth.

#### How does Google Cloud support multicloud strategies?

Google Cloud supports robust multicloud strategies through our commitment to openness and interoperable technologies. We provide consistent platforms like Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) for managing applications across environments, and our Google Distributed Cloud solutions extend our infrastructure where you need it, ensuring you can leverage the best of all clouds without being locked in.

#### How does Google Cloud support healthcare and life sciences organizations in achieving their sustainability goals?

Google Cloud helps organizations achieve their sustainability goals by providing solutions to monitor and optimize energy consumption across their enterprise. These tools track and measure environmental impact, including carbon footprint, water usage, and waste. Google Cloud also assists in generating ESG reports, and offers 24/7 carbon-free energy, leading to lower operational costs, a sustainable future, and enhanced brand image through demonstrated environmental responsibility.

#### How long does it take to move to Google Cloud?

The time it takes to migrate to Google Cloud depends on the scope and complexity of the project. Factors like the amount of data across the organization and the specific migration strategy play a role in determining the overall timeline. Google Cloud and/or your partner of choice will help you scope your project, set priorities, and determine a realistic timeline.
